title: CrisisGuardUnifiedCrisisIntelligenceRecord
description: Standardized schema contract for crisis information features output by Phase 7 engines (HumAID, CrisisMMD, CrisisLex). Preserves source provenance without forced blind concatenation.

content_id.description: Unique identifier for the content item (e.g. humaid_123, cmmd_456, clex_789)

source_record_id.description: Underlying record identifier from raw data source

event_id.description: Event-level identifier or disaster incident name

text_available.description: True if textual content was present and processed, False if unhydrated/missing

image_available.description: True if local image binaries were physically present, False otherwise

crisis_category.description: Ground truth or model predicted crisis humanitarian category

task_name.description: Classification or feature extraction task name

model_score.description: Raw uncalibrated model score or class probability

provenance.description: Lineage metadata tracing back to raw/processed splits

model_version.description: Version identifier of model generating feature

prediction_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when feature was computed
